name: @commandrelay/run-core
description: Run orchestration contracts for durable CommandRelay tasks

scripts.build: npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm exec -- node ../../scripts/packages/run-node-tests-if-present.mjs dist-test && npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test',{recursive:true,force:true})"
